titleTr: Son zamanlarda ne yapıyorsun? Present Perfect Continuous

explainTr: Present Perfect Continuous (have/has been + V-ing) geçmişte başlayıp hâlâ süren ya da yeni biten eylemi anlatır: I have been studying for two hours. Süreye ve sürece odaklanır.
Kullanım: 1) Süren eylem + for/since: She has been working here since 2020. 2) Şimdi görülen bir sonucun nedeni: His hands are dirty. He has been working in the garden.
Biten ve sayılan işlerde Present Perfect Simple kullanılır: I have read three chapters. Süreç değil sonuç önemlidir. Olumsuz: haven't/hasn't been + V-ing.
grammar.compareTr: Türkçede 'iki saattir çalışıyorum' dersin. İngilizce bunu 'I have been working for two hours' diye söyler; şimdiki zaman (I am working for two hours) yanlıştır.
table: He has been working since 8 a.m.

reading.title: Three busy months
reading.text:
For the last three months, Hafsa has been preparing for her substitute teacher certificate. Her days are very full. She has been getting up at six, making breakfast for Emre, and studying for two hours before she goes to the school library. "I have been reading the state handbook every day," she says. "It has many rules about safety and attendance."

She has also been taking an online course about classroom management. Last week she finished the third lesson, and she has already completed twelve quizzes. In the evenings, Linda has been helping her practice with flashcards. "Hafsa has been working so hard that I am a little jealous," Linda jokes.

The process is not only studying. Hafsa has been collecting documents too. She has sent her application, and she has given her fingerprints for the background check. The results haven't arrived yet, so she has been checking her email every day.

Lately Hafsa has been feeling tired but proud. "My English has been improving every week," she says. "At first, I was afraid of the handbook. Now I understand most of it."

Her next step is the final exam at the end of the month. She has been practicing sample questions every night, and she has already read the handbook twice. "I am not afraid anymore," she says with a smile. "I am just very, very busy."

options: Write an email to Mr. Brown

writing.promptTr: Bir arkadaşına son zamanlarda neler yaptığını anlatan kısa bir e-posta yaz (80-120 kelime). have/has been + V-ing kullan.
writing.promptEn: Write an email to a friend about what you have been doing lately. Use the present perfect continuous.
writing.model:
Hi Linda,

How are you? I am sorry I haven't called. I have been very busy lately. I have been preparing for my substitute teacher exam for three months. Every morning I have been reading the handbook, and every evening I have been practicing questions.

I haven't been sleeping very well, so I am tired. But I am also proud because my English has been getting better. I have been using flashcards, and they really help.

Emre has been helping me too. He has been asking me questions at dinner. Can we have coffee this weekend?

Your friend,
Hafsa
